story: Browse completed research or catalog → local search/filter → read complete report → inspect economics and linked sources. Static read-only pages; no API or database.

checks.axe: WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA: zero detected violations on homepage, catalog, latest report, method page at all three viewports
checks.overflow: No horizontal document overflow on all four page types at three viewports
checks.javascript_disabled: Homepage and report readable without JavaScript
checks.source_boundary: Only completed v2 matching records with report files become report routes; public output allowlist passed
checks.runtime: No page errors in search/read navigation test
checks.manual_visual_review: Desktop/mobile home, mobile/tablet longform and desktop catalog screenshots inspected

resolved_findings: Astro moves compiled chunks, so content root now resolves from repository ancestry rather than module URL.
Ephemeral environment has no writable default Astro config directory; build uses ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.
Astro preview background mode did not satisfy Playwright process lifetime; test harness serves built static output via Python.
Chapter number contrast increased; final accessibility scans pass.
Desktop TOC test now checks the details.open property, not truthiness of an empty HTML attribute.
